findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed at least 8 dented cans in the facility. PIC was informed that cans that are dented on the top, bottom, or side seams or cans that are dented such that the dents come to a pointed edge pose the risk of botulism growth and food-borne illness transmission. The PIC will remove the dented cans when time allows, for he is the only employee currently present at the facility.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.
